story.titleZh: 红牛确认哈贾尔伤愈复出，劳森回归小红牛
story.summaryZh: 红牛确认伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕伤愈，本周末将重返赛车。利亚姆·劳森在代打三场比赛后回归小红牛，角田裕毅再次担任储备车手。

story.summaryEn:
Red Bull confirms Isack Hadjar will be back in the car this weekend after recovering from his wrist injury
Liam Lawson returns to Racing Bulls after three races as a replacement for Hadjar, and Yuki Tsunoda is on reserve duties again #F1 #AzerbaijanGP
